name: Anito
description: The spirits of the ancestors and of nature, honored with offerings.
sources: William Henry Scott, Barangay: Sixteenth-Century Philippine Culture and Society (Ateneo de Manila University Press, 1994)
Juan de Plasencia, Customs of the Tagalogs (1589), in Blair and Robertson, The Philippine Islands 1493–1898, vol. 7

lore.en: Anito were the spirits of ancestors and of the natural world. Households kept carved figures of them and made offerings of food and drink. A babaylan or katalonan led larger rites for the whole community. Keeping good relations with the anito was part of daily life.
lore.fil: Ang anito ay mga espiritu ng ninuno at ng kalikasan. May mga inukit na larawan nila sa bawat tahanan at hinahandugan sila ng pagkain at inumin. Pinangungunahan ng babaylan o katalonan ang malalaking ritwal ng buong pamayanan. Bahagi ng araw-araw na buhay ang mabuting pakikitungo sa anito.

inGame.en: Offerings at the Dambana build Favor. Spend it on the Anito blessing: +20% production for 5 minutes.
inGame.fil: Nagpaparami ng Favor ang handog sa Dambana. Gamitin ito sa Basbas ng anito: +20% produksyon sa loob ng 5 minuto.

hint.en: Raise a shrine near the babaylan.
hint.fil: Magtayo ng dambana malapit sa babaylan.
